guards.what: G1 (LIVE): the whole relic is a no-op stub, justified by a docstring claim -- 'the sim has no enchantments' -- that is FALSE
guards.issue: MECHANISM: MysticLighter.cs:15-30 returns `DynamicVars.Damage.IntValue` (DamageVar(9m, ValueProp.Unpowered), MysticLighter.cs:13) from ModifyDamageAdditive whenever the damage is a powered attack (:17), the cardSource carries an Enchantment (:21) and that card belongs to the owner (:25). mystic_lighter.py:8-9 implements nothing and says 'the sim has no enchantments, so this is a no-op stub'. PREMISE FALSE (PROMPT.md bug class 12): sts2_rl/enchantments.py is ported with 17 enchantments (executed count in the probe), enchantments themselves already implement this exact hook (enchantments.py:333, :404, :454), and Card carries an `enchantment` attribute the relic could read. REACHABILITY (LIVE, executed -- py tools/audit/relic_probes_b10.py mystic-lighter): an enchanted Strike deals 6 damage with the relic attached and 6 without; C# deals 15. Both sides ported and obtainable: Mystic Lighter is SHOP rarity in the transcribed grab bag (relic_pools.py, executed by this module's `pool` probe), and three ported relics enchant a deck card the player then attacks with -- relic/beautiful_bracelet (Swift), relic/electric_shrymp (Imbued) and relic/nutritious_soup (Tezcatara's Ember on every Basic Strike, audited in this same batch). IMPLEMENTATION NOTE for whoever fixes it: the sim's hook signature is modify_damage_additive(target, amount, dealer, card) with NO `props` argument, but DamageCmd already restricts the call to powered attacks (cmds.py:56, `if is_powered_attack(props)`), so C#'s `!props.IsPoweredAttack()` guard is structurally satisfied and no signature change is needed -- a one-method fix on the relic. The constant is 9 with no AscensionHelper call anywhere in MysticLighter.cs. Rule 7: enchantments.py, cmds.py, hooks.py, relics/base.py, relic_pools.py, relics/beautiful_bracelet.py, relics/electric_shrymp.py and relics/nutritious_soup.py are NOT hashed by this record.

guards.what: N1: .superpowers/sdd/content-relic-sweeps.md Sweep C EXCLUDES this hook from its 33 'live pipeline' hits on the grounds that ModifyDamageAdditive is 'not a HookSystem hook' and 'needs a new base hook'
guards.issue: Recorded because it changes the finding's SIZE, not just its wording: the sweep files Mystic Lighter among the drops that are 'larger than a one-relic fix', which would park it behind a pipeline change that is not needed. It IS a HookSystem hook -- `modify_damage_additive` is defined at hooks.py:52 and dispatched at cmds.py:57 -- and the dispatcher duck-types (`if hasattr(l, 'modify_damage_additive')`), so no member on Relic is required. EXECUTED root cause: sweep-stub-premises maps a C# hook name to a sim hook with `_RUN_HOOK_MAP.get(h) or (h if h in combat_hooks else None)` (tools/audit/relic_probes.py:1073), where `h` is a PascalCase C# name and `combat_hooks` holds snake_case HookSystem method names, so the second branch can never match and every dropped COMBAT hook outside the run-level `_RUN_HOOK_MAP` is silently skipped. I re-ran the mapping for all seven hooks the sweep excludes on that basis and exactly ONE is a real HookSystem hook: ModifyDamageAdditive (this relic). Filed in .superpowers/sdd/relic-batch-10-lessons.md; the sweep document and probe module are read-only to this batch, so neither was edited. The verdict carried here is G1's, per binding rule 4 -- this entry adds no new divergence, it corrects the cost estimate of G1's fix. Rule 7: tools/audit/relic_probes.py, hooks.py, cmds.py and the sweeps document are unhashed (tools/audit/** is never hashed by any record).
